verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents end-to-end experimentation, with multivariate A/B/n variants, a managed event warehouse and a built-in Bayesian results engine. An official MCP server and Admin API give agents programmatic access, and the docs say anything in the dashboard can be done via the Admin API. That implies experiment configurations and results are readable, but nothing explicitly shows results being exposed through the API or MCP tools, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for reading experiment results and statistics, a machine-readable API spec, and hands-on or independent confirmation of an agent summarizing experiment outcomes.
